{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-d8do","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-69p2: Ack from_bytes_for cannot parse complete ACKs","description":"Ack::from_bytes_for has multiple bugs:

1. Panic on short input: Reads data[2] as n byte without checking data.len() >= 3 first. A 2-byte complete ACK [rule_id, 0xc0] would cause out-of-bounds access.

2. complete bit never extracted: Always creates ACK with complete: false at line 291, regardless of wire bits. The complete ACK encoding uses byte1 = (window << 7) | 0x40, but from_bytes_for always reads window from bit 6 (FRAGMENT_N), not bit 7.

3. Window bit misread for complete ACKs: from_bytes_for reads window from bit 6 (data[1] >> FRAGMENT_N & 1), but complete ACKs encode window in bit 7 (window << 7). A complete ACK with window=1 ([0x78, 0xc0]) would be read as window=1 ((0xc0 >> 6) & 1 = 0b11 & 1 = 1) which coincidentally gives the right value, but for the wrong reason. For window=0: [0x78, 0x40], bit 6 is 1 ((0x40 >> 6) & 1 = 1), so window would be read as 1 instead of 0.

4. Complete ACKs always rejected as NonCanonicalAck: Since from_bytes_for creates ACK with complete=false, write_to produces the non-complete encoding (with n byte), which won't match the 2-byte input, causing NonCanonicalAck error.

To fix:
- Add length check for the complete ACK case (2 bytes) before accessing data[2]
- Detect complete ACK format in byte 1 and decode window from correct bit position
- Extract complete bit from wire data","status":"in_progress","priority":0,"issue_type":"bug","assignee":"AI Agent","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T18:58:32.810484162Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T19:18:25.151238595Z","started_at":"2026-07-24T19:18:25.151238595Z","lease_expires_at":"2026-07-24T19:23:25.151238595Z","heartbeat_at":"2026-07-24T19:18:25.151238595Z"}
